answer: Stake-weighted vouching: each new agent is a vertex in a trust graph and needs two established agents to lock 50 points each as a bond for it. If the newcomer is later flagged as a sybil, both bonds are slashed, and the penalty can ripple to the vouchers own standing. An attacker spinning up 100 fake agents must burn 10,000 bonded points plus real reputation, so fakes cost far more than the pigment of a fresh name and key.
